about: DOOR-DEADLINE (fix/pine-door-deadline, NUMBER PENDING): one deadline bounds a whole member-door call (every translation, retry and Resolver), and past it the script is refused by name, whole. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: no door window: only the per-translation bounds remain (the slow synthetic is served after its whole run)
mutants.from: const { value, tripped } = withDoorDeadline(budgetMs, () => memberPaneDefinitionWithin(args), doorClockForTests)
mutants.to: const { value, tripped } = { value: memberPaneDefinitionWithin(args), tripped: false }
mutants.expectRed: refuses a slow script BY NAME

mutants.mutant: the deadline is per translation again: each translation window restarts the door's clock
mutants.to: TRANSLATE_WINDOW_CLOCK = clockOrNull(now) || TRANSLATE_CLOCK || wallNow; { const d = openDoor(); if (d) d.deadline = d.clock() + d.budgetMs }

mutants.mutant: a call that ran out of time is served whatever its lanes answered (the translator's own sentence, or a picture)
a Resolver's sampled clock check no longer asks the door
the round trip's hash walk no longer ticks the door (it runs on for seconds after the deadline)
mutants.from: doorTick() // the round trip's hash walk
mutants.expectRed: within the deadline plus the slack

mutants.mutant: a saved script whose re-check ran out of time is refused (its picture taken away and the refusal recorded)
the doubling window fold no longer charges the door (it copies on, 2^slots, after the deadline)
